messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: capacity.surge.queue_backlog (severity: P1). Affected service: inference-runtime-prod. Trigger: queue depth > 95th percentile for 3min. Links: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/INC-9251 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: Paging @amanda.g (primary) -> @ryan.m (secondary). Escalation in 2m.

amanda.g: ack @pagerduty here, looking now. any notes on customer impact?

ryan.m: watching, moving to thread. I see token queue lag on hotpath nodes, tail latency > 3s for 90% of requests.

kevin: logs showing autoscaler controller not creating pods. Error in controller: `failed to acquire instance quota: quota_exceeded`. Cloud quota spike around 02:14 UTC.

amanda.g: that matches. autoscaler health shows last successful reconcile 02:10, then repeated `429` from cloud API.

infra-bot: Metric snapshot: queue_depth=1863, avg_proc_time=320ms, tail_latency_p95=3100ms, available_gpus=12, pending_scale_requests=6.

sara: FYI ops dashboard shows a backlog on redis-kv-cache for prefixes - lots of cache-misses -> increases work. could be contributing.

amanda.g: customer impact: several high-throughput customers seeing elevated latency and some 5xx errors when worker pools exhaust. Not yet full outage but degraded. tagging #customers-impacted for comms.

ryan.m: quick mitigation idea: manual scale up of dedicated pool to add capacity. However cloud quota blocks the autoscaler; we can try to spin up on a different zone/instance type.

kevin: trying `gcloud compute instances create` (different SKU) now. attaching command: ```
ZONE=us-central1-b
gcloud compute instances create ri-infer-temp-001 --machine-type=a2-highgpu-1g --zone=$ZONE --image-family=redwood-inference-2026
```

amanda.g: while kevin does that, I'll open a k8s debug shell and check the scale controller logs. `kubectl -n infra logs deployment/scale-controller --since=15m`

kevin: new node booting, expected ready in ~90s.

infra-bot: New node `ri-infer-temp-001` registered at 02:18:32 UTC. GPU allocation available.

ryan.m: routing some burst traffic to the new node set via feature flag `route:hotpath:allow-temp`. Pushing config: `redwoodctl route set --route hotpath --targets +temp-pool`

sara: also toggled kvcache prefix-ttl to 60s to reduce regen load: `kvctl set global.prefix_ttl 60` — should reduce immediate miss storm.

amanda.g: scale-controller logs show cloud API 429s cleared around 02:19 after rate-limit backoff. Reconcile loop resumed, created 4 pods.

kevin: confirming workers draining backlog. queue_depth dropping: 1863 -> 920 -> 400 in 3 minutes. tail latency p95 -> 1.2s.

amanda.g: good. marking incident as partial mitigation. still monitoring for recurrence. prepping blameless postmortem notes.

ryan.m: action items:
- short term: increase cloud quota request and open ticket with cloud provider (kevin).
- medium: add cross-zone pool fallback in autoscaler logic (engineering).
- short term: add alert for kvcache miss storms causing regen (sara).

kevin: created cloud support case #CS-88921, requested emergency quota raise for GPUs in us-central1.

sara: added eval rule to detect sustained cache-miss ratio > 0.3 for 5m.

amanda.g: handing off to @ryan.m for night watch. I'll update incident timeline and customer comms template. If anything spikes, escalate to on-call infra lead.

ryan.m: taking watch. summary for handoff: autoscaler hit cloud quota -> controller backoff -> manual temp nodes and route fanout patched the backlog down; cache regen amplified load. Current state: degraded -> recovering. monitor for 30m.

pagerduty: Escalation acknowledged by @ryan.m. PagerDuty incident INC-9251 status: acknowledged.

amanda.g: closing active mitigation but leaving thread open for notes. adding pin: `Mitigation: manual temp nodes + route fanout + kvcache ttl tweak`.

infra-bot: Post-incident snapshot saved to /incidents/2026/3572468012/metrics.json.

ryan.m: will follow up with a short postmortem tomorrow. any objections to tagging this P1->P2 in 6h if stable?

sara: OK from me.

kevin: fine.

amanda.g: fine. marking follow-up: quota request, cross-zone fallback, kvcache eval rule. I'll draft comms for affected customers. :white_check_mark:
